response.overview: Desperate for validation, a clown named Andoy finds himself in front of a group of millennials and Gen Z adults, drinking and mocking his act.  Behind the cheerful façade of the clown hides deep humiliation and long-suppressed rage, leading him to turn a mocking audience into victims in a brutal, unforgettable performance, blending psychological horror with themes of validation and suppressed emotion.
response.title: Andoy
